sections.heading: Overview

sections.content:
Delivery of Leadership Workshops under the Fresh Start Program to build the leadership, communication and people‑management capability of NSW local government employees.
The Leadership Program is a core workforce development initiative under the Fresh Start Program and is designed to strengthen current and future leaders' skills, confidence and capability to effectively lead technical and operational teams. The workshops will focus on practical leadership skills tailored for council operational contexts, with a strong emphasis on leadership styles, organisational, time management, communication and decision making.
sections.heading: Project goals

sections.content:
End-to-end delivery of workshops across metropolitan, regional and rural NSW, in virtual and face-to-face format (if appropriate).
- Design and delivery of leadership workshop modules
- Provision of course materials, facilitation resources and supporting documentation
- Administration of participant engagement requirements
- Collection of program evaluation data
- Maintain regular communication with councils
- Provide progress updates
See RFT documentation for further details.
